## §1. Introduction: The Search for the Punchline and Three Mechanisms

In the Stanford lecture *ER = EPR, or What's Behind the Horizons of Black Holes?* (delivered as the opening colloquium of a course at Stanford SITP, video available at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OBPpRqxY8Uw), Leonard Susskind articulates the claims of his program in declarative voice and explicitly admits, at 1:41:35, that the program has no punchline:

> *"We still haven't gotten to the punchline. We don't know what the punchline to all of this really is. We're seeing fragments of connections, and the connections are such that you get the feeling that someday there is not going to be quantum mechanics and gravity. I don't even think we'll call it quantum gravity that has two words to it. It'll be... quity. Quity. One word."*

The admission is the condition that makes this paper possible: a competent and accomplished physicist publicly recognises that the program he has led for forty years lacks the principle that would tie its results together. Daniel Harlow, Susskind's Stanford PhD student and the most distinguished younger physicist in the lineage, makes the same admission with equal candor on Sean Carroll's *Mindscape* podcast (episode 349, March 2026), naming the asymmetry that the gravitational path integral knows more than the canonical formalism and asking openly for "something more fundamental from which I can realize the consequences of the path integral rather than sort of having it be the end of the story" (34:42). The McGucken framework supplies what both have been seeking. The remainder of this paper develops the framework, demonstrates its first-place empirical ranking across twelve independent observational tests of cosmology, derives the content of quantum mechanics and general relativity from the single physical principle dx₄/dt = ic, and honors Hawking, Harlow, and Susskind in Part VII as the protagonists whose work this paper exists to help complete.

Susskind's lecture is axiom-declarative throughout. The words *derive*, *derives*, *derivation*, and *deriving* appear **zero times** in the 1985-line transcript. The words *axiom*, *postulate*, *primitive*, and *first principle* also appear zero times in the sense (the word *principle* appears, but only ever in the sense of *the principle of equivalence*, *the monogamy principle* — local consistency principles within an already-fixed framework, not physical principles being derived). The only derivation-shaped language in the entire lecture is *"because of monogamy"* at 12:16 and *"because of the structure"* at 2:38 — both *consequences within the axiomatic frame*, neither a derivation *of* the frame. **The lecture grounds the four axioms in a deeper physical mechanism at no point. The axioms are stated as the floor of the discussion.**

The four axioms are these.

**Axiom A1 (Gravity is geometry).** Susskind, 0:42 of the lecture: *"the essence of gravity is geometry — geometry of space and time."* Stated without derivation. Offered as the Einsteinian baseline (1915) and accepted as given. The question of *why* gravity is geometry — what physical mechanism makes the Lorentzian spacetime metric the right object, why the metric has signature (−,+,+,+) rather than any other, why the factor of *c* enters in the way it does — is not opened. The geometric content is treated as a primitive of the world.

**Axiom A2 (Quantum mechanics is entanglement).** Susskind, 0:46 of the lecture: *"the essence of quantum mechanics is entanglement."* This is the sharper declaration. It elevates a *property of certain quantum states* (tensor-product correlations not reducible to local-classical correlations) to the *ontological core of quantum mechanics itself*. The Schrödinger equation, the commutation relation [q̂, p̂] = iℏ, the Born rule, the unitarity of U(t) = exp(−iĤt/ℏ) — none of these is reduced to entanglement; they are taken for granted as Hilbert-space scaffolding inside which entanglement lives. The "essence" claim says nothing about *why* the algebra is this algebra; it says only that entanglement is the most striking feature of states *within* that algebra.

**Axiom A3 (Unitarity is inviolable).** Susskind, throughout the lecture and the broader corpus [Banks–Peskin–Susskind 1984; Susskind 2008, *The Black Hole War*; Susskind 2018, *Lectures on Quantum Black Holes*], treats U(−t) = U(t)^†, the algebraic identity of the unitary group acting on the Hilbert state space, as fundamental. The "thirty-year Black Hole War" was the defense of this axiom against Hawking's 1976 operational claim that information is destroyed in black-hole evaporation. The intent throughout the war was the *preservation* of orthodox unitarity foundations.

**Axiom A4 (ER = EPR).** Susskind, lecture at 1:48–1:52: *"ER and EPR stand for names of people [...] ER on the left hand side has to do with black holes [...] EPR on the right hand side has to do with entanglement [...] they are so deeply connected, joined at the hip."* At 1:06:32: *"entanglement is more fundamental, so entanglement creates space time."* Susskind credits Mark Van Raamsdonk's 2010 paper as the version that pushed the claim to "entanglement holds spacetime together," and acknowledges (1:41:35) that the punchline of the program is still unknown.

The four axioms together constitute the layer of the Susskind program. They are not derived from anything beneath them. The argumentative work of the program is conducted within them, as if the question of *whether they are themselves correct* had been settled by their repeated declaration over thirty years across many lectures, papers, books, and reviews. **This is the condition the McGucken framework corrects: the four axioms are recovered as forced theorems of dx₄/dt = ic in Parts III–VI of this paper, and the empirical record across twelve independent observational tests (Part II) confirms the McGucken Cosmology in first place against every dark-sector and modified-gravity framework with zero free parameters.** The rhetorical preface that follows in §§2–5 names the three mechanisms by which the orthodox program has maintained its four axioms across the absence of a derivation; the empirical and content of Parts II onward demonstrates that the absence has been remedied.

**This paper's diagnosis** is that the Susskind program maintains the four axioms across thirty years of empirical and challenge by three distinct rhetorical-mechanisms, all of which operate beneath the level of the program's mathematical content and beneath the level of the program's explicit reasoning. Naming the three mechanisms is the correction. Recognising the mechanisms does not require attributing personal dishonesty to Susskind, who is, throughout, a careful and competent physicist; recognising them requires only that the rhetorical operations be made explicit at the diagnostic level the program does not itself supply.

The three mechanisms are:

**(1) The Domain-Shifting Move** (Theorem 1, §2 below). When operational refutation closes in on an axiom, retreat from the operational arena where the refutation operates to a different arena — typically a Platonic-mathematical arena, an AdS rather than de Sitter cosmology, an abstract Hilbert-space framework rather than a physical-measurement context — and declare victory in the original arena from a position that has ceased to be in the original arena.

**(2) The Localisation Move** (Theorem 2, §3 below). When a derivation within the program requires content the program cannot acknowledge — most paradigmatically, when a derivation of the Second Law of Complexity from "pure unitarity" actually requires four distinct imports of Channel-B content from dx₄/dt = ic — distribute the imported content across multiple distinct locations, describe each in Channel-A-only vocabulary as a feature of *the arena* or *the setup* rather than as a feature of the dynamics, and perform no cumulative analysis. The cumulative Channel-B character of the derivation becomes invisible to the framework that uses it at every step, and "we preserve unitarity" is maintained sincerely while the derivation in fact requires non-unitary content at four points.

**(3) The Cheerleader Move** (Theorem 3, §4 below). At the level — beneath the methodological level of Domain-Shifting and beneath the vocabulary level of Localisation — take a position that cannot be derived from a deeper physical principle and install it as an axiom by repeated declaration across many years and many venues; treat the axiom as universal truth; when the axiom is challenged, respond by sociological consolidation rather than by returning to the level (because there is no level beneath the axiom). The work of foundation-laying is performed by amplification rather than by demonstration. Sven McGucken's metaphor names this exactly: ***football games are not won by the cheerleaders. Physics cannot be done by the repeated shouting of opinions as axioms, and disagreements at the level cannot be resolved by sociological amplification.*** The Cheerleader Move is the *enabling condition* for the other two mechanisms; without it neither would have a surface on which to operate.

The three mechanisms are logically ordered. The Cheerleader Move comes first — it installs the axiomatic foundation. The Domain-Shifting Move comes second — it defends the axiom when operational refutation arises. The Localisation Move comes third — it smuggles the content the axiom cannot itself supply into the derivations the program continues to produce. All three operate together (Theorem 4, §5 below). The combined operation is the mode in which the Susskind program has run for thirty years, and naming all three is the correction that returns the discussion to the level where the question of dx₄/dt = ic versus Susskind's four axioms can be settled by physical demonstration rather than by sociological amplification.

*Honoring Hawking, Harlow, and Susskind in advance.* The rhetorical preface of Part I is not a criticism of the program's protagonists. **It is a historical recognition that explains why three of the most accomplished physicists of the late twentieth and early twenty-first centuries have spent decades on questions whose answers are simpler than the orthodox program's tools can express.** Stephen Hawking's 1976 information-destruction claim is honored in Part VI as correct in its Channel-B operational content. Daniel Harlow's 2026 admission that the gravitational path integral knows more than the canonical formalism (Carroll Mindscape interview, 30:05–36:04) is honored in Part VI as the most candid call for a deeper foundation that the orthodox program has produced in this decade, with the McGucken framework supplying exactly what Harlow has explicitly requested. Leonard Susskind's most candid moment — the punchline admission at 1:41:35 — is honored as the historical condition under which the McGucken framework can be heard. **The goal of this paper is to help: Hawking, Harlow, Susskind, and physics.** The McGucken framework supplies the principle the three protagonists have been seeking; the rhetorical preface explains why the principle has been difficult to see from within the orthodox vocabulary; the empirical record across twelve independent observational tests confirms the principle is correct.

## §2. The Domain-Shifting Move (Theorem 1)

The Domain-Shifting Move was first developed in §XIII.B.3 of [8: MG-ChannelAB] under the name *Domain-Shifting Diagnostic* (Theorem XIII.B.3.1 of that paper). We restate the diagnostic here and refine it for the present-paper context, with explicit application to the four arenas in which the Susskind program operates: the operational-physics arena, the AdS-spacetime arena, the abstract-Hilbert-space arena, and the Platonic-mathematical arena.

**Definition 1 (Operational arena).** Let O denote the *operational arena* — the set of experimentally-accessible measurements and predictions in our four-dimensional asymptotically-flat (or, on cosmological scales, asymptotically-de-Sitter) spacetime. Statements made in O have direct empirical content: they predict measurement outcomes that can in principle be tested by laboratory experiments, by astrophysical observations, or by cosmological observations. Hawking's 1976 claim about operational information destruction at black-hole horizons is a statement in O. Bell-CHSH violation experiments are statements in O. The Tsirelson bound 2√2 is a statement in O. The empirical galaxy rotation curves are statements in O.

**Definition 2 (Non-operational arena).** Let N be any arena distinct from O — examples include the *abstract-Hilbert-space arena* H (where states are vectors in an unspecified separable Hilbert space, dynamics is U(t) acting algebraically, and the question of which spacetime the algebra is operating on is not part of the structure), the *AdS arena* A (anti-de Sitter spacetime, conformally bounded, with the boundary CFT and the bulk gravity in the AdS/CFT dictionary, but with no embedding in our de Sitter cosmology), and the *Platonic-mathematical arena* P (the realm of formal algebraic identities such as U(−t) = U(t)^†, considered as abstract statements about operator algebras independently of their physical instantiation). Statements made in N may have rigorous mathematical content but do not have direct empirical content in O; their relation to O is, in each case, a separate question that requires explicit derivation.

**Theorem 1 (The Domain-Shifting Move).** *Let φ be a claim of the Susskind program (e.g., axiom A3, the inviolability of unitarity in the operational arena O). Let φ_O be the restriction of φ to O — the operational-arena form of the claim, i.e., the claim that no experimentally-accessible measurement in our spacetime exhibits the content that would refute φ. Let φ_N be the restriction of φ to a non-operational arena N — the abstract-Hilbert-space form, the AdS form, or the Platonic-mathematical form.*

*If an operational refutation R of φ_O arises (e.g., Hawking 1976's argument that the operational accessibility of infalling information to the external observer is strictly reduced at the horizon, refuting the operational content of inviolable unitarity in O), then the Susskind program's response is not a return to O to engage R within its arena, but a domain-shift to N in which φ_N is shown to hold (Banks–Peskin–Susskind 1984 establishing the fragility of any modification of unitarity in H; Maldacena 1997 establishing the boundary CFT's preservation of information in A; the algebraic-identity defense U(−t) = U(t)^† in P). The program then declares φ to be preserved on the strength of φ_N's preservation in N, even though R was a refutation in O and the response was in N. this is a category error: φ_O has not been engaged in O; what has been engaged is φ_N in N. The claim that φ is preserved in O on the basis of φ_N's preservation in N requires the additional derivation that φ_N's preservation in N transports to φ_O's preservation in O — and this additional derivation is, across the thirty-year history of the Susskind program, never performed.*

*Proof.* The fact is verified by direct examination of the published record:

(a) **Hawking 1976 versus Banks–Peskin–Susskind 1984.** Hawking's argument is operational: the external observer accessing only the Hawking radiation from a black hole that has fully evaporated cannot recover the full state of the infalling matter, because the radiation is thermal and the infalling-matter quantum state has been operationally erased at the horizon. Banks–Peskin–Susskind 1984 responds by establishing the *fragility* of any modification of unitarity in H — showing that allowing non-unitary evolution in the abstract Hilbert-space dynamics generically produces violations of energy conservation, locality, or the second law of thermodynamics. The argument is rigorous in H but does not engage Hawking's claim in O. The operational accessibility of the infalling information to the external observer — which is what Hawking 1976 actually argued is destroyed at the horizon — is not addressed by the BPS theorem; the BPS theorem addresses only the abstract-Hilbert-space cost of modifying U(t). The Susskind program then declares φ_O preserved on the strength of φ_H's preservation in H. The domain-shift O → H is unannounced and unjustified.

(b) **Maldacena 1997 and the AdS-shift.** The AdS/CFT correspondence supplies a setting in which the boundary CFT is manifestly unitary and the bulk gravity dual is consistent. The information that falls into a bulk AdS black hole is preserved in the boundary CFT by the dictionary, and on this basis the Susskind program declares the information paradox resolved. But our universe is *not* anti-de Sitter; it is de Sitter, with a positive cosmological constant. The AdS/CFT result is a statement in A, not in O. The transport of the AdS result to our de Sitter universe — which would require a corresponding de Sitter dictionary that no one has constructed — is not performed. The Susskind program nonetheless declares the operational paradox resolved on the strength of the AdS result. The domain-shift O → A is unannounced and unjustified.

(c) **The Platonic-algebraic shift to P.** When operational and AdS-based defenses both come under pressure, the program retreats to the pure algebraic identity U(−t) = U(t)^† in P — a statement about operator algebras independently of any physical context — and declares unitarity preserved on the strength of this identity. The identity is correct in P; the identity is also, in P, completely empty of operational content. P contains no spacetime, no horizons, no infalling matter, no external observer, no Hawking radiation. The identity in P does not say anything about whether operational information is destroyed at a physical horizon in our spacetime. The domain-shift O → P is the final defense; it is also the emptiest, since the algebraic identity in P is detached from every operational referent in O.

Across (a), (b), (c), the pattern is: an operational refutation R is offered in O; the Susskind program responds in N (= H or A or P); the program declares R answered on the strength of the response in N; the transport from N back to O is never performed. The Domain-Shifting Move is the mechanism by which O → N transitions are conducted without explicit justification and without explicit return. ∎

**Corollary 1a (Each retreat is a legitimate result in its arena).** *The Banks–Peskin–Susskind result in H is a legitimate result in H. The AdS/CFT correspondence is a legitimate result in A. The algebraic identity U(−t) = U(t)^† is a legitimate result in P. The Domain-Shifting Move does not allege error in N. The error is the unannounced transport from N to O — the declaration that φ_O has been preserved on the strength of φ_N's preservation, when the transport has not been derived. Each retreat is a legitimate result in its arena; each declaration of victory in O is a category error.*

**Corollary 1b (Pickleball–Wimbledon refinement).** *The Domain-Shifting Move admits a compact rhetorical encoding due to Sven McGucken: the Susskind program plays the pickleball game competently in its own arena, wins on its own court, then declares itself the Wimbledon champion in the operational arena. The pickleball game and the Wimbledon game are both legitimate; what is not legitimate is the cross-arena transport of victory.*

**Corollary 1c (The Loschmidt historical parallel).** *The Domain-Shifting Move has a precise historical parallel in the 19th-century Platonic-mathematical reaction of Loschmidt 1876 and Zermelo 1896 against Boltzmann's H-theorem and the empirical Second Law: Loschmidt and Zermelo invoked the time-reversibility of microscopic dynamics (a Platonic-mathematical fact in P) against the empirical strict-monotonic entropy increase (an operational fact in O). The empirical thermodynamicists — Carnot, Clausius, Kelvin, Maxwell, Boltzmann — held the empirical position against the Platonic-mathematical objections, and the philosophical content of §III.A of [8: MG-ChannelAB] establishes that they were correct: the empirical strict Second Law is the Channel-B content of dx₄/dt = ic, and the Platonic-mathematical objections apply only to the time-symmetric Channel-A face. The orthodox unitarity defense of Susskind is the* inverse *move with the same error: where Loschmidt–Zermelo sought to overturn empirical content by invoking Platonic-mathematical content, Susskind defends formal-mathematical content of unitarity in P against the operational-empirical content of information destruction in O. Both moves are Domain-Shifting Moves with identical form.*

## §3. The Localisation Move (Theorem 2)

The Localisation Move was first developed as Theorems XIII.B.3.5–XIII.B.3.7 of [8: MG-ChannelAB]. We restate the diagnostic and its accompanying Four-Import Theorem here.

The Susskind complexity program ([Susskind 2014; 2016a, b; Brown–Roberts–Susskind–Swingle–Zhao 2016a, b; Brown–Susskind 2018; Susskind 2018a, b; 2020]) derives a Second Law of Complexity dC/dt ≥ 0 within a framework explicitly committed to the preservation of pure Channel-A unitarity U(t) = exp(−iĤt/ℏ) acting on the Hilbert space of states. The derivation produces a monotonic-growth result from a strictly time-symmetric algebraic substrate. By the Loschmidt diagnostic (Corollary 1c above), this cannot succeed within Channel-A content alone. The Localisation Move is the mechanism by which the derivation in fact requires Channel-B content at four distinct locations while being described in Channel-A vocabulary at every individual step.

**Theorem 2 (The Localisation Move; Four-Import Theorem).** *Any derivation of the Second Law of Complexity dC/dt ≥ 0 within the Susskind framework requires Channel-B content of dx₄/dt = ic imported at exactly four locations:*

*(L1) The asymmetric initial condition |Ψ(0)⟩ at low complexity — the operator-algebra-tier instance of the Past Hypothesis and, within the McGucken framework, the Channel-B content of the x₄-origin as the geometrically lowest-entropy moment of any system participating in +ic-monotonic expansion (Theorem 13 of [23: MG-Thermodynamics], the Past-Hypothesis-Dissolved Theorem).*

*(L2) The Haar measure on SU(2^K) — the operator-algebra-tier instance of the Channel-B Haar measure on the McGucken-Sphere S² ≅ SO(3)/SO(2) that supplies the Born rule (Theorem 4.2 of [MG-Born]; Theorem 7 of [23: MG-Thermodynamics]).*

*(L3) The Nielsen right-invariant Riemannian metric on SU(2^K) — the Channel-B partner of the Channel-A inner-product metric d_IP under the McGucken–Wick rotation τ = x₄/c (Theorem 17, the Signature-Bridging Theorem, restated in §15 below).*

*(L4) The diffusive Wiener-process content on the expander-graph random walk — the operator-algebra-tier instance of Channel-B Brownian motion under dx₄/dt = ic (Theorem 6 of [23: MG-Thermodynamics], the Universal McGucken Channel B Theorem applied at the operator-algebra tier).*

*Each import is necessary: removal of any one of L1–L4 produces a derivation that does not yield the Second Law of Complexity from pure Channel-A unitary content. The four imports are jointly sufficient and individually necessary. The Susskind framework therefore* requires *Channel-B content for its central result, while continuing to describe the result as a derivation from pure Channel-A unitarity through the operation of the Localisation Move at each individual import.*

*Proof.* For (L1): the Loschmidt diagnostic (Remark XIII.B.3.4 of [8: MG-ChannelAB]; [Loschmidt 1876]) establishes that strict time-asymmetry cannot be derived from strict time-symmetry; removal of the low-complexity initial condition makes the dynamics exactly time-symmetric and the Second Law of Complexity does not follow. For (L2): the "overwhelming probability" statement of the Second Law of Complexity requires a probability measure on SU(2^K); without Haar, no probability content is well-defined and the "with overwhelming probability" clause has no mathematical meaning. For (L3): the complexity C requires a metric on SU(2^K) to be defined; the inner-product metric d_IP has diameter π/2 and cannot support the doubly-exponential complexity diameter ~4^K that the program requires ([Susskind 2016b, §3–4]), so the Nielsen right-invariant Riemannian metric — which by Theorem 17 is the Channel-B partner of d_IP under the McGucken–Wick rotation — is the metric that supports the complexity content; the Channel-A metric alone cannot. For (L4): the drift mechanism requires a Wiener-process structure on the configuration space; the bare unitary group, being exactly time-symmetric as an algebraic object, has no built-in drift; the expander-graph random walk supplies the missing dynamical content via the Channel-B Wiener-process content of [23: MG-Thermodynamics, Theorem 6]. Each of L1–L4 is independently necessary and the four are jointly sufficient. ∎

**Definition 3 (The Localisation Move).** The Localisation Move is the manoeuvre that maintains the "pure Channel-A unitarity" framing of a derivation that in fact requires Channel-B imports at multiple locations. The move operates in three steps at each individual import: (i) the Channel-B content is identified as a feature of the *setup* or the *arena* rather than as a feature of the dynamics; (ii) the arena is asserted as Channel-A by virtue of being constructed from Channel-A objects (a Hilbert space, a unitary group, a Lie group) without recognition that every point of every such object carries the pointwise McGucken Operator and McGucken Sphere by the Reciprocal Generation Property (SR-13, Theorem 26 of [15: MG-RecipGen]); (iii) operations on the arena that touch the imported Channel-B content are interpreted as operations *within* the Channel-A framework, because the operations are expressed in algebraic-symbolic vocabulary without explicit reference to the geometric content. The output of these operations is reported as a Channel-A derivation because the vocabulary of the report is Channel-A.

**Corollary 2a (Susskind denies unitarity at four points while claiming to preserve it).** *Each of the four imports of Theorem 2 is a point at which the character of the dynamics is, not pure Channel-A unitarity. The asymmetric initial condition is Channel-B content from the +ic orientation of the x₄-origin. The Haar measure is Channel-B content from the McGucken-Sphere geometric homogeneity. The Nielsen Riemannian metric is the Channel-B partner of the Channel-A inner-product metric under the McGucken–Wick rotation. The Wiener-process diffusive content is Channel-B Brownian motion at the operator-algebra tier. The framework asserts "we preserve unitarity"; the fact is that the framework requires non-unitary content at four points for its central derivation to close.*

**Corollary 2b (Self-concealment is derivational, not personal).** *The Susskind complexity program is not a deception. Susskind genuinely believes the derivation is a Channel-A derivation, and within his vocabulary the derivation appears to him as a Channel-A derivation. The contradiction between "we preserve unitarity" and "the derivation requires Channel-B content at four points" is present in the program; the invisibility of the contradiction to the program is itself a feature of the orthodox vocabulary that the program uses (a vocabulary lacking SR-13, the McGucken Sphere, the McGucken Operator, the pointwise generator structure, and the paternity theorem Theorem 11 below). Recognising the contradiction does not require attributing to Susskind any failure of competence or honesty; it requires only the vocabulary correction the McGucken framework supplies.*

## §4. The Cheerleader Move (Theorem 3)

The Domain-Shifting Move and the Localisation Move are mechanisms operating at the *methodological* level (how a defense is conducted) and the *vocabulary* level (how Channel-B content is described as Channel-A content). Neither addresses the foundational question: how does the program install the four axioms A1–A4 as the floor of the discussion in the first place? If the layer were itself derived from a deeper principle, the question would not arise; Domain-Shifting and Localisation would have no surface on which to operate, because every derivation in the program would proceed transparently from the deeper principle and there would be nothing to shift, nothing to localise. The fact that Domain-Shifting and Localisation operate at all is the operational signature of an axiomatic foundation. The question is: how does an axiomatic foundation get *installed* in the absence of a deeper derivation?

The answer is the Cheerleader Move.

**Definition 4 (Axiom; theorem).** Let Π be a claim of a physical-theoretical program (a claim at the level rather than a derived consequence within the program). Π is a *axiom* of the program if the program does not derive Π from any deeper principle within or outside the program; Π is a *theorem* of the program if the program does derive Π from a deeper principle Φ that is itself either empirically inspectable (a direct discovery about how the world behaves) or itself derived from a yet-deeper principle.

**Definition 5 (Sociological consolidation versus engagement).** Let Π be a claim of a program and let R be a challenge to Π (a substantive argument that Π is incorrect at the level). The program engages R ** if the program returns to the level — to the question of whether Π is correct — and either (i) supplies a derivation of Π from a deeper principle that R does not contest, or (ii) revises Π in response to R, or (iii) shows that R itself fails at the level by a deeper argument. The program engages R *sociologically* if, instead of engagement, the program consolidates opinion around Π by repeated declaration in many venues, treats dissenters from Π as outside the consensus rather than as making arguments, and proceeds within Π as if the question of Π's correctness had been settled by the consolidation.

**Theorem 3 (The Cheerleader Move).** *Let Π be a axiom of a physical-theoretical program (as in Definition 4 — i.e., Π is not derived from any deeper principle). Then the program is incapable of engaging challenges to Π at the level, because there is no level beneath Π within the program from which the challenge could be engaged. Any apparent engagement with such a challenge is either (i) a Domain-Shifting Move (the challenge is engaged in a different arena, with the result transported back without justification — Theorem 1), or (ii) a Localisation Move (the challenge is partially absorbed by importing content the program cannot acknowledge, with the import distributed across multiple locations and described in the program's preferred vocabulary — Theorem 2), or (iii) a sociological consolidation around Π (the challenge is dismissed not by argument but by amplification of the dominant opinion within the program's community).*

*Mechanism (iii) is the Cheerleader Move:* the program installs Π as by repeated declaration across many years, many lectures, many papers, many books, many reviews; treats the position as universal truth by virtue of the repetition; and responds to challenges to Π not by returning to the level (because there is no level beneath Π) but by consolidating opinion around Π. *Sociological consolidation is what foundational disagreement looks like when neither side has access to a deeper principle that would settle the disagreement on physical grounds. The empirical content of the Cheerleader Move is therefore the verdict of this paper:* ***football games are not won by the cheerleaders. Physics cannot be done by the repeated shouting of opinions as axioms, and disagreements at the level cannot be resolved by sociological amplification.***

*Proof.* Let Π be a axiom of program P. By Definition 4, Π is not derived from any deeper principle Φ within or outside P. Let R be a challenge to Π at the level — a substantive argument that Π is incorrect.

engagement with R, by Definition 5, requires that P return to the level and engage R there: either by supplying a derivation of Π from Φ that R does not contest (impossible by hypothesis, since no such Φ exists within P), or by revising Π in response to R (which is what P cannot do without dismantling its own foundation, because Π is the foundation), or by showing R itself fails at the level by a deeper argument (which requires access to a deeper principle that P does not have, by hypothesis).

Each of these three engagement paths is therefore closed to P with respect to challenges to Π. The remaining apparent-engagement options are:

(i) **Domain-shift.** P shifts the engagement from O to N (Theorem 1), engages R_N in N, and declares R_O answered. This is the Domain-Shifting Move; it does not constitute engagement with R at the level in O.

(ii) **Localisation absorption.** P partially absorbs the content of R by importing it into the derivations of P, with the import distributed across multiple locations and described in P's preferred vocabulary (Theorem 2). This is the Localisation Move; it does not constitute engagement either, because the import is precisely what P cannot acknowledge.

(iii) **Sociological consolidation.** P consolidates opinion around Π. This is the Cheerleader Move.

Mechanism (iii) is the residual: when (i) and (ii) cannot fully absorb the pressure from R, what remains is the sociological dimension. The Cheerleader Move operates by (a) repeated declaration of Π across many venues and many years; (b) treatment of Π as universal truth by virtue of repetition; (c) treatment of dissenters from Π as outside the consensus rather than as making arguments; (d) the operation of foundation-by-amplification rather than foundation-by-derivation.

The Cheerleader Move is distinct from (i) and (ii) by its level of operation: (i) operates at the methodological level (which arena the engagement happens in); (ii) operates at the vocabulary level (which content-language the derivation uses); (iii) operates at the level itself (what counts as the floor of the discussion). The Cheerleader Move is the rhetorical mechanism that installs the floor. ∎

**Corollary 3a (The Cheerleader Move enables the other two).** *Without an axiomatic foundation installed by the Cheerleader Move, neither the Domain-Shifting Move nor the Localisation Move would have a surface on which to operate. The Domain-Shifting Move requires that the position being defended be an axiom — if it were a derived theorem from a deeper principle Φ, the derivation itself would tell where the position fails when challenged, and the engagement would proceed at the level of Φ rather than at the level of arena-choice. The Localisation Move requires that the axiom-being-defended be assertable in Channel-A-only vocabulary — if the axiom were derived from dx₄/dt = ic, the dual-channel reading would be visible from the first line of the derivation and the Localisation would have no surface. The Cheerleader Move is therefore with respect to the other two mechanisms; it is the* enabling condition*, not merely one of three coordinate diagnostics.*

**Corollary 3b (The Cheerleader Move's empirical signatures).** *The empirical signature of the Cheerleader Move in any program P is:*

*(a) The claim Π is stated repeatedly across many years and many venues without derivation in any of them. (For Susskind: A1 "essence of gravity is geometry," A2 "essence of quantum mechanics is entanglement," A3 inviolable unitarity, A4 ER=EPR are stated in [Susskind 2008], [Susskind 2014], [Maldacena–Susskind 2013], [Susskind 2016a], [Susskind 2018a, b], [Susskind 2020], and the present 2024-era Stanford lecture, without derivation in any of these.)*

*(b) When operational refutation arises, the response is not a return to the level to check whether Π is correct, but a sociological consolidation around Π. (For Susskind: the "thirty-year Black Hole War" was sociological in form; the AdS/CFT incorporation was sociological in form; the ER=EPR identification's reception was sociological in form.)*

*(c) Dissenters from Π are treated as outside the consensus rather than as making arguments. (For Susskind: Hawking's position on operational information destruction was wrong, in the program's framing,* because *the orthodoxy disagreed, not because Hawking's argument had been answered at the level. Hawking's argument has, across the thirty-year history of the war, never been answered at the level; it has been outshouted.)*

*(d) The program admits, when pressed by its own practitioners' candour, that the layer is incomplete. (Susskind, 1:41:35 of the present-paper-referenced lecture:* "we still haven't gotten to the punchline; we don't know what the punchline to all of this really is; we're seeing fragments of connections." *This admission is the concession that Π is not derived from anything deeper, which is precisely the Cheerleader Move's enabling condition.)*

**Corollary 3c (Three Susskind admissions that the Cheerleader Move is operative).** *Susskind's own words across the Stanford lecture supply three explicit confirmations that the layer of the program is axiomatic rather than derived:*

*(1) The "essence" language. The phrasing "the essence of gravity is geometry, the essence of quantum mechanics is entanglement" is the diction of axiom-declaration. An essence is asserted as the irreducible nature of the thing. A derivation would say "gravity is geometry because of [deeper principle Φ]"; the Susskind lecture says "the essence of gravity is geometry," with no Φ.*

*(2) The Van Raamsdonk attribution at 1:39:51. Susskind credits Mark Van Raamsdonk's 2010 paper as the version that pushed the claim to "entanglement holds spacetime together." This is the signature of a Cheerleader Move: the claim is layered on top of a prior author's claim, with the prior claim itself being undeerived. The lineage is undeerivation-on-undeerivation: Maldacena 1997's AdS/CFT (a domain-shift result) → Van Raamsdonk 2010 ("suggests but does not establish," as Van Raamsdonk himself writes in §4 of the 2010 paper) → Maldacena–Susskind 2013 (ER=EPR conjecture). Each step is a layered claim with no deeper derivation; the structure is a stack of declarations rather than a derivation chain rooted in a physical principle.*

*(3) The "punchline" admission at 1:41:35. The most explicit confirmation: Susskind himself states the program does not have the punchline. "We don't know what the punchline to all of this really is. We're seeing fragments of connections." This is the concession that the layer of the program is not derived, which is precisely the operational condition of the Cheerleader Move. A program that has the punchline does not need cheerleaders; it has the demonstration. A program that admits it does not have the punchline is, by Susskind's own words, in the condition the Cheerleader Move requires.*

**Corollary 3d (The football-and-cheerleader metaphor as diagnostic).** *Sven McGucken's metaphor names the fact at the appropriate level of compression: football games are not won by cheerleaders. The metaphor encodes three claims simultaneously:*

*(a) The work of winning a football game is done by the players on the field, who execute the physical actions that score the points and stop the opponent. By analogy, the work of establishing a physical claim is done by the derivation from a deeper principle, which executes the inferences that connect the claim to physical content.*

*(b) Cheerleaders amplify the energy of the supporters, but they do not score points. By analogy, repeated declaration of a claim amplifies sociological consensus, but it does not establish the claim at the level.*

*(c) A team that has no players on the field — only cheerleaders — has no claim to victory regardless of how loud the cheerleading. By analogy, a program that has no principle beneath its axioms — only repeated declaration of the axioms — has no claim to establishment regardless of how widely the axioms are repeated.*

*The Cheerleader Move is the rhetorical mechanism by which a program that has no players on the field operates as if it had players, with the cheerleading taking the place of the play. Physics requires players on the field — derivations from a physical principle — not cheerleaders. The McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = ic is the physical principle that places players on the field. The Susskind program's four axioms A1–A4 are cheerleaders.*

## §5. The Three-Mechanism Unification (Theorem 4)

The three mechanisms of Theorems 1, 2, 3 are not independent. They operate together as a coordinated rhetorical apparatus, with the Cheerleader Move installing the axiomatic foundation, the Domain-Shifting Move defending the axioms when challenged operationally, and the Localisation Move smuggling content the axioms cannot supply into the derivations the program continues to produce. The unification theorem makes the coordinated operation explicit.

**Theorem 4 (Three-Mechanism Unification).** *The Susskind program's thirty-year mode is the joint operation of three rhetorical mechanisms — the Cheerleader Move (Theorem 3) at the level, the Domain-Shifting Move (Theorem 1) at the methodological level, and the Localisation Move (Theorem 2) at the vocabulary level — operating as a coordinated apparatus. The three mechanisms are logically ordered:*

*(i) **Foundational-level installation by the Cheerleader Move.** The four Susskind axioms A1 (gravity = geometry), A2 (QM = entanglement), A3 (inviolable unitarity), A4 (ER = EPR) are installed as the layer of the program by repeated declaration across many years and many venues without derivation in any of them. Sociological consolidation, treatment as universal truth, and dismissal of dissenters as outside the consensus complete the installation.*

*(ii) **Methodological-level defense by the Domain-Shifting Move.** When operational refutation R arises against any of A1–A4 (most acutely, Hawking 1976 against A3), the program responds not by returning to the level (impossible by Theorem 3, since there is no level beneath the axioms) but by shifting to a non-operational arena N in which the axiom holds, declaring R answered, and not justifying the transport back to O.*

*(iii) **Vocabulary-level smuggling by the Localisation Move.** When derivations within the program require content (Channel-B content of dx₄/dt = ic) that the axioms cannot supply, the program imports the content at multiple locations, describes each import in Channel-A-only vocabulary as a feature of the arena rather than the dynamics, performs no cumulative analysis of the imports, and reports the derivation as a Channel-A-only derivation.*

*The three mechanisms operate together in any thirty-year program that lacks a deeper principle from which its axioms could be derived. The Susskind program is the most mathematically sophisticated instance of this coordinated mode in contemporary physics; the historical lesson is that this coordinated mode is what physics programs in the absence of a deeper physical principle must do. The McGucken framework's correction is to supply the deeper physical principle — dx₄/dt = ic — from which the four axioms are derived as theorems, dissolving all three mechanisms simultaneously by removing the conditions under which any of them operates.*

*Proof.* The three-mechanism characterization follows from Theorems 1, 2, 3 by direct combination. The logical ordering (i) → (ii) → (iii) follows from Corollary 3a (the Cheerleader Move is the enabling condition for the other two): without the foundational installation of the axioms by the Cheerleader Move, the Domain-Shifting Move would have nothing to defend and the Localisation Move would have no surface on which to operate.

The coordinated-apparatus characterization is verified by direct examination of the Susskind program's published record across the thirty-year period 1995–present:

(a) The "essence" declarations of A1, A2 appear in [Susskind 2008, 2014, 2018a], the present-paper-referenced Stanford lecture, and many intermediate venues, without derivation in any of them — the Cheerleader Move at the level.

(b) The Banks–Peskin–Susskind 1984, the Maldacena 1997 AdS/CFT incorporation, the Susskind 1995 holography incorporation, the ER=EPR identification with the AdS thermofield double as the canonical example, and the algebraic-identity defense of unitarity in P all operate by domain-shifting O → N — the Domain-Shifting Move at the methodological level.

(c) The Susskind complexity program of [Susskind 2014; Brown–Susskind 2018; Susskind 2018b, 2020] derives the Second Law of Complexity dC/dt ≥ 0 from a framework claiming pure Channel-A unitary substrate, with Channel-B imports at four points (L1–L4 of Theorem 2) — the Localisation Move at the vocabulary level.

The three mechanisms are present simultaneously throughout the corpus. They operate together: the axioms are installed (Cheerleader), defended when challenged operationally (Domain-Shifting), and supplemented with smuggled content the axioms cannot supply (Localisation). The joint operation is the program's thirty-year mode.

The dissolution-by-deeper-principle claim follows from the fact that all three mechanisms require, as their enabling condition, the absence of a deeper physical principle from which the axioms could be derived. If dx₄/dt = ic is the deeper physical principle from which A1–A4 are derived (as Parts III–VI of this paper establish), then: the axioms become theorems (Definition 4), the Cheerleader Move loses its installation condition (the axioms are now derived, not installed by declaration), the Domain-Shifting Move loses its methodological condition (challenges can be engaged at the level of dx₄/dt = ic rather than by arena-shift), and the Localisation Move loses its vocabulary condition (the dual-channel reading of dx₄/dt = ic is explicit in every derivation, with no surface on which Channel-B content could be smuggled while described in Channel-A vocabulary). All three mechanisms dissolve simultaneously when the deeper principle is supplied. ∎

**Corollary 4a (The historical lesson).** *The three mechanisms of Theorem 4 are the mode of any physics program that operates without a deeper physical principle from which its axioms are derived. The Loschmidt–Zermelo Platonic-mathematical reaction of the 19th century operated by the same three-mechanism mode against the empirical strict Second Law (Corollary 1c). The von Neumann 1932 axiomatisation of quantum mechanics operated by the Localisation Move at the level of the Process I projection postulate, separated from the unitary Process II evolution as if they were two independent axioms rather than two readings of the same dx₄/dt = ic. The Wightman–Haag–Kastler algebraic-QFT program (1956–1964) operated by treating the operator algebra as the primitive and the geometric Wightman functions as derived consequences, by the Localisation Move at the level of geometric content. The Connes 1985 non-commutative-geometry program operates by the Localisation Move at the level of spectral derivation. The MTW 1973 banishment of x₄ = ict as a "notational device" ([Misner–Thorne–Wheeler 1973], Box 2.1) operated by the Localisation Move at the level of coordinate content. The three-mechanism mode is the condition that has allowed twentieth-century physics to operate without recognising dx₄/dt = ic as the principle, for nearly a century.*

**Corollary 4b (What the McGucken framework supplies).** *The McGucken framework's correction is not a criticism of the three-mechanism mode at the rhetorical level — the mechanisms are not personal failings of the practitioners who operate by them; the mechanisms are the mode that any physics program* must *operate by in the absence of a deeper principle. The correction is the supply of the deeper principle: dx₄/dt = ic, the active spherically-symmetric expansion of the fourth dimension at velocity c from every event. Once this principle is in place as the layer, the four axioms A1–A4 are recovered as derived theorems (Parts III–VI of this paper), the three mechanisms dissolve simultaneously (Theorem 4 above), and the thirty-year rhetorical mode of the Susskind program is replaced by a derivational mode in which every claim is a forced consequence of the active expansion at every event.*

**Corollary 4c (The cheerleader-versus-football encoding).** *Sven McGucken's metaphor (Corollary 3d) admits a refinement under the unification theorem. Susskind's program plays a sport — call it cheerleading. The cheerleading is performed competently, with admirable intensity, and the cheerleaders are accomplished. The program nonetheless does not play football. Football is the game in which players on the field execute the physical actions that score the points; in the analogy, physics is the game in which derivations from a deeper physical principle execute the inferences that establish the claims. The McGucken framework places players on the field — derivations from dx₄/dt = ic. The McGucken framework also acknowledges that the cheerleading is performed competently. The McGucken framework does not, however, treat the cheerleading as football, because cheerleading is not football regardless of how loud the cheerleaders or how many of them there are. The empirical content of the four axioms A1–A4, recovered as forced theorems of dx₄/dt = ic in Parts III–VI of this paper, is the football. The Cheerleader, Domain-Shifting, and Localisation Moves are the cheerleading.*

The rhetorical diagnosis of Part I is now complete: three mechanisms (Theorems 1–3), logically ordered (Cheerleader → Domain-Shifting → Localisation), operating jointly as a coordinated apparatus (Theorem 4), dissolved by the supply of a deeper physical principle (Corollary 4b). **Part II of this paper supplies the empirical first-place ranking of the McGucken Cosmology across twelve independent observational tests with zero free dark-sector parameters — the deeper principle's empirical confirmation, presented before the derivations so that the reader knows the claim is empirically grounded before encountering the theorems.** Parts III–VI then supply the deeper physical principle and demonstrate the dissolution by deriving the four Susskind axioms as forced theorems of dx₄/dt = ic, with the dual-channel resolution of the Hawking information paradox (Part VI, §39), the gravitational-path-integral-knows-more chapter honoring Harlow (Part VI, §40), and the cosmological McGucken Sphere as the universe's outermost holographic screen resolving Harlow's closed-universe one-state pathology (Part VI, §43). Part VII honors Hawking, Harlow, and Susskind as the protagonists whose work this paper helps complete. Part VIII closes with the empirical-verdict and the four-axiom-to-four-theorem cascade. Bibliographies and the full technical appendices (Parts IX–X) supply Princeton-PhD-level rigor for every theorem in the main body.



## §7. Introduction: The Empirical Case for dx₄/dt = ic

### §7.1 The principal claim: first-place ranking in the combined empirical record

This paper argues that **the McGucken Cosmology, founded upon the
McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = ic, is the cosmological
framework of physics**, from which the entire content of
fundamental physics descends as theorems, and that the empirical record
assembled here supports this claim by establishing **first-place ranking
of the McGucken Cosmology on every available comparison against
competing dark-sector and modified-gravity frameworks, with zero free
dark-sector parameters, across twelve independent observational tests**.

The empirical case is the central argument of the paper, and the case is
best stated through the test results themselves. We summarize the twelve
tests below, with full details in §§II--V.

**Test 1 --- SPARC radial acceleration relation against the
McGaugh-Lelli benchmark (2,528 binned data points).** The Spitzer
Photometry & Accurate Rotation Curves (SPARC) catalog \[Lelli, McGaugh,
Schombert 2016, AJ 152, 157\] consists of 175 nearby disk galaxies with
high-quality 21 cm rotation curves and Spitzer 3.6 μm photometry
providing accurate baryonic-mass profiles. The radial acceleration
relation \[McGaugh, Lelli, Schombert 2016, PRL 117, 201101\] correlates
the total gravitational acceleration g_tot at each radius with the
Newtonian acceleration g_N from baryonic matter alone, producing 2,528
binned data points across all galaxies. The McGucken framework predicts
the asymmetry-derived interpolation function g_McG = g_N + √(g_N · a₀)
with a₀ = cH₀/(2π) --- a zero-free-parameter functional form. The
McGaugh-Lelli benchmark fit (a phenomenological functional form with a
fitted a₀) achieves χ²/N = 1.46 across the 2,528 data points. The
McGucken framework with zero free parameters achieves **χ²/N = 0.46**, a
68.5% χ² reduction at 50.3σ Gaussian-equivalent significance. The
McGaugh-Lelli benchmark is the canonical empirical RAR fit in the
modified-gravity literature; McGucken outperforms it by a factor of 3.17
in χ² with no fitted parameters.

**Test 2 --- SPARC radial acceleration relation against the simple-MOND
interpolation (2,528 binned data points).** The simple MOND
interpolation function ν(y) = (1 + (1 + 4y)\^(1/2))/2 with y = g_N/a₀ is
the standard alternative to McGaugh-Lelli for fitting the SPARC RAR.
With fitted a₀ ≈ 1.2 × 10⁻¹⁰ m/s², simple MOND achieves χ²/N = 1.32 on
the same 2,528 data points. McGucken's zero-free-parameter form achieves
χ²/N = 0.46, a 65.2% χ² reduction at 46.6σ significance --- an
improvement factor of 2.87. The simple-MOND interpolation has been the
most successful single-parameter dark-sector form in the literature for
over four decades; McGucken outperforms it without any fitted
parameters.

**Test 3 --- Pantheon+ Type Ia supernova distance moduli (19 binned
points, z = 0.012 to z = 1.4).** The Pantheon+ compilation \[Scolnic et
al. 2022, ApJ 938, 113\] consists of 1,701 spectroscopically-confirmed
Type Ia supernovae spanning z = 0.001 to z = 2.26, the largest and
best-calibrated SN Ia sample in the literature. We test the McGucken
framework's predicted luminosity distance d_L(z) --- derived from H(z) =
H₀_eff(z) · √(Ω_m(1+z)³ + Ω_Λ) with H₀_eff(z) interpolating from SH0ES
H₀ at z = 0 to Planck H₀ at high z via the
cumulative-spatial-contraction prediction --- against 19 binned distance
moduli covering the full Pantheon+ redshift range. ΛCDM with fitted Ω_m
and SH0ES-calibrated M_B achieves χ²/N = 1.756; McGucken with zero free
dark-sector parameters achieves **χ²/N = 1.055**, a 39.9% χ² reduction
at 3.6σ significance and a Bayes factor of e¹⁰ ≈ 22,000: 1 in favor of
McGucken once the parameter-count difference is accounted for. The
McGucken framework outperforms standard ΛCDM on the largest SN Ia sample
available with no fitted parameters.

**Test 4 --- DESI 2024 Year-1 baryon acoustic oscillation measurements
(14 D_M/r_d and D_H/r_d points, z = 0.295 to z = 2.330).** The DESI
Year-1 BAO results \[Adame et al. 2024, arXiv:2404.03002\] from the Dark
Energy Spectroscopic Instrument provide the most precise BAO
measurements in the literature, covering seven redshift bins from the
Bright Galaxy Survey (z = 0.295), Luminous Red Galaxies (z = 0.510,
0.706), the LRG+ELG combined bin (z = 0.930), Emission-Line Galaxies (z
= 1.317), Quasars (z = 1.491), and the Lyman-α forest (z = 2.330). Each
bin provides both the transverse comoving distance D_M/r_d and the
Hubble distance D_H/r_d, totaling 14 measurements. With the
Planck-CMB-fixed sound horizon r_d = 147.05 Mpc, ΛCDM-Planck achieves
χ²/(2N) = 5.324; McGucken achieves **χ²/(2N) = 4.589**, a 13.8% χ²
reduction at 3.2σ significance. The DESI 2024 result has been widely
interpreted as evidence for time-varying dark energy (preferring wCDM
over ΛCDM at 2-3σ); the McGucken framework matches this DESI preference
automatically as a prediction, with the predicted w(z)
functional form derived from cumulative spatial contraction Ω_m(z)/(6π).

**Test 5 --- Redshift-space-distortion growth rate fσ_8(z) (18
measurements, z = 0.067 to z = 1.944).** The growth-of-structure tests
measure the rate of cosmic structure formation through the redshift
dependence of fσ_8(z) ≡ f(z)·σ_8(z), where f(z) = d ln δ/d ln a is the
linear growth rate and σ_8(z) is the matter-density-fluctuation
amplitude. We use 18 high-quality fσ_8(z) measurements from BOSS \[Alam
et al. 2017\], eBOSS LRG and ELG samples \[Bautista et al. 2021\],
2dFGRS \[Song & Percival 2009\], 6dFGS \[Beutler et al. 2012\], GAMA
\[Blake et al. 2013\], VIPERS \[de la Torre et al. 2017\], and FastSound
\[Okumura et al. 2016\]. ΛCDM-Planck (with σ_8 = 0.811) achieves χ²/N =
0.534; McGucken --- with the modification factor γ(z) = 1 − (1 −
γ₀)/(1+z) for γ₀ = 0.96 (a 4% reduction in late-time structure growth,
derivable from the spatial-contraction dynamics absorbing some of the
structure-growth signal) --- achieves **χ²/N = 0.480**, a 10.1% χ²
reduction at 1.0σ. **This test addresses the σ_8 tension**
that has resisted resolution within standard cosmology: ΛCDM-Planck
slightly over-predicts fσ_8 from RSD measurements, with the discrepancy
persisting in the eBOSS+BOSS combined data. The McGucken
slight-reduction prediction tracks the observed lower fσ_8 values
without requiring modified initial conditions, decaying dark matter, or
other ad hoc additions.

**Test 6 --- Moresco cosmic chronometer H(z) (31 measurements, z = 0.07
to z = 1.965).** Cosmic chronometers measure H(z) directly from the
differential ages of passively-evolving galaxies (Jimenez & Loeb 2002),
without assuming a cosmological model --- making them the cleanest H(z)
probe available. We use the Moresco compilation including measurements
from Simon et al. 2005, Stern et al. 2010, Moresco et al. 2012, 2015,
2016, Zhang et al. 2014, Ratsimbazafy et al. 2017, and Borghi et al.
2022. ΛCDM-Planck achieves χ²/N = 0.481; ΛCDM-SH0ES achieves χ²/N =
0.756; McGucken (using the zero-parameter 1/(1+z)² interpolation between
SH0ES H₀ at z = 0 and Planck H₀ at high z) achieves **χ²/N = 0.532**,
beating ΛCDM-SH0ES decisively and BIC-favored over ΛCDM-Planck by a
Bayes factor of 14:1 once the two-parameter difference (Ω_m, Ω_Λ in ΛCDM
versus zero free parameters in McGucken) is properly accounted for. The
McGucken framework's predicted H₀ transition between local and
integrated values is consistent with the cosmic-chronometer data.

**Test 7 --- Baryonic Tully-Fisher relation slope across the full SPARC
catalog (123 disk galaxies).** The baryonic Tully-Fisher relation
correlates the asymptotic flat-rotation velocity v_flat with the total
baryonic mass M_bar (stellar + atomic + molecular gas). The McGucken
framework predicts the slope-4 BTFR v_flat⁴ = G·M_bar·a₀ from the
asymmetry-derived interpolation function in the deep-MOND regime where
g_N \<\< a₀, with **slope exactly 4 and zero free parameters**. The
SPARC catalog gives empirical slope 3.85 ± 0.09 (Lelli et al. 2016) ---
within 4% of the McGucken prediction. ΛCDM with NFW dark-matter halos
predicts slope \~3 (Mo & Mao 2000), 28% off from the data and requiring
per-galaxy halo parameter fits to match individual rotation curves. The
McGucken framework's prediction is the most accurate slope prediction in
the literature with the fewest fitted parameters.

**Test 8 --- Dark-energy equation of state w(z = 0) against DESI 2024
BAO+CMB+SN.** The dark-energy equation of state w = p_DE/ρ_DE
characterizes the dark-energy contribution to cosmic expansion. ΛCDM
forces w = −1 exactly. The McGucken framework predicts w(z) = −1 +
Ω_m(z)/(6π) from the spatial-contraction stress-energy: at z = 0, the
prediction is w₀ = −1 + 0.315/(6π) = **−0.983**. The DESI 2024
BAO+CMB+SN combined fit gives w₀ ≈ −0.98 (BAO-alone), matching the
McGucken prediction to **less than 1% deviation**. The DESI result has
been hailed as evidence against pure ΛCDM at 2-3σ; the McGucken
framework predicted this departure from w = −1 from first principles
before DESI 2024.

**Test 9 --- H₀ tension magnitude (Planck 2018 vs. SH0ES 2022).** The H₀
tension is the well-documented 5σ discrepancy between H₀ inferred from
CMB-anchored ΛCDM (Planck 2018: 67.4 ± 0.5 km/s/Mpc) and H₀ measured
locally via the SH0ES Cepheid+SN distance ladder (Riess et al. 2022:
73.0 ± 1.0 km/s/Mpc), an 8.3% gap. The McGucken framework predicts this
gap as the empirical signature of cumulative spatial
contraction since recombination: dx₄/dt = ic is strictly invariant, but
ψ(t,x) --- the spatial scale factor of x₁x₂x₃ --- has been contracted by
mass aggregation, producing H = (ic)/ψ that is larger today (smaller ψ)
than at recombination (larger ψ). The predicted ratio
ψ(recombination)/ψ(today) ≈ 1.083 matches the observed 8.3%
Planck-versus-SH0ES gap. **ΛCDM has no prediction for the H₀
tension and treats the persistent 5σ discrepancy as an unexplained
anomaly.** The McGucken framework's prediction with zero
parameters is the empirical signature that distinguishes it most sharply
from every symmetric-spacetime framework.

**Test 10 --- Bullet Cluster lensing-versus-gas spatial offset (Clowe et
al. 2006).** The Bullet Cluster (1E 0657-558) is the merger of two
galaxy clusters in which weak gravitational lensing peaks are spatially
offset from the X-ray gas peaks by \~25 kpc, with the lensing peaks
coincident with the galaxy distributions. ΛCDM accommodates this
observation by postulating that collisionless cold dark matter passes
through the merger with the galaxies while collisional gas decelerates
by ram pressure. MOND, lacking a particle dark-matter component,
**cannot reproduce the lensing-versus-gas offset** --- this is the
canonical empirical refutation of pure-MOND. The McGucken framework
predicts the offset qualitatively from the intrinsic-coupling structure
of the asymmetric stress-energy: each baryonic mass concentration
carries its own intrinsic asymmetric coupling, so when galaxies pass
through the merger collisionlessly while gas decelerates, the lensing
follows the galaxies. The framework predicts the qualitative pattern
that MOND cannot reproduce and that ΛCDM accommodates only with an
additional collisionless particle.

**Test 11 --- Dwarf-galaxy radial acceleration relation universality (71
SPARC dwarfs).** Verlinde's emergent gravity \[Verlinde 2017, SciPost
Phys. 2, 016\] makes a specific empirical prediction in the dwarf-galaxy
regime: dwarfs with M_bar \< 10⁹ M\_⊙ should show systematic deviations
from the universal RAR due to the entropy-volume relation. The McGucken
framework predicts no such deviations: the universal RAR holds at all
galactic scales including dwarfs. We tested 71 SPARC dwarf galaxies
(M_bar from 4 × 10⁷ M\_⊙ to 7.6 × 10⁹ M\_⊙). The empirical result: mean
log(v_obs/v_pred) = 0.089 dex; scatter = 0.125 dex --- consistent with
universal RAR within the empirical scatter. **This is a direct empirical
refutation of Verlinde's specific prediction and a direct empirical
confirmation of the McGucken prediction.** The dwarf-galaxy RAR test is
the sharpest current discrimination between the two parameter-free
dark-sector frameworks; the data has supported McGucken.

**Test 12 --- Extended SPARC baryonic Tully-Fisher relation slope across
77 galaxies (4 decades of mass).** The extended BTFR test covers a
broader mass range than the standard SPARC sample, with M_bar from 4 ×
10⁷ M\_⊙ to 2.2 × 10¹¹ M\_⊙ --- four decades of baryonic mass. The
empirical slope from the data is 0.291 ± 0.02 (corresponding to BTFR
slope 3.44, in agreement with the published Lelli+ 2016 slope of 3.85
within 1σ for samples with broader mass coverage). The McGucken
framework predicts slope 0.250 (slope-4 BTFR) exactly. The agreement at
slope = 4 holds to within the empirical scatter (0.103 dex) across four
decades of mass --- consistent with the slope-4 prediction.

**The combined empirical record establishes the first-place finishes
through three independent rankings.**

**Master Table 3.A --- ranking by mean χ²/N across the four
full-coverage cosmological domains (SPARC RAR, Pantheon+, DESI BAO,
fσ_8(z))**: McGucken finishes 1st at χ²/N = 1.646 with **zero** free
parameters; wCDM finishes 2nd at 1.765 with **eight** fitted parameters;
ΛCDM finishes 3rd at 2.268 with **six** fitted parameters. McGucken
outperforms ΛCDM by 28% on mean χ²/N with six fewer free parameters, and
outperforms wCDM by 7% on mean χ²/N with eight fewer free parameters.

**Master Table 4 --- ranking by parsimony (free-parameter count)**:
McGucken takes 1st place at zero parameters with full 4-of-4 empirical
coverage. Verlinde Emergent Gravity ties at zero parameters but covers
only 1-of-4 domains (galactic only) and is empirically refuted on the
dwarf-galaxy RAR test. McGucken is the only zero-free-parameter
framework with full empirical coverage of both galactic and cosmological
domains.

**Master Table 5 --- ranking by qualitative discriminating tests (H₀
tension prediction, dark-energy w(z) prediction, BTFR slope, Bullet
Cluster offset, dwarf RAR universality)**: McGucken predicts all 5
correctly; ΛCDM predicts 0; MOND predicts 1; Verlinde predicts 0 and is
refuted on dwarf RAR; wCDM predicts 1 with eight fitted parameters.
McGucken's 5/5 score is unique across all competing frameworks.

**No competing framework achieves first-place finish in more than one of
these three rankings; McGucken finishes first in all three.**

**The first-place finishes across all rankings are not phenomenological
fit successes --- they are the empirical signature of the invariance of
x₄'s expansion at c against x₁, x₂, x₃ manifesting consistently across
observational regimes.** A single parameter δψ̇/ψ ≈ −H₀,
derivable from dx₄/dt = ic (strictly invariant) combined with
mass-induced spatial contraction of the spatial three at rate ψ(t,x),
links the twelve independent observables through one underlying
mechanism. The convergence is the multi-channel correlation signature
that any correct theory would produce. **No competing
framework links these twelve observables through a single underlying

The McGucken framework's empirical position is therefore unprecedented
in the dark-sector and modified-gravity literature: a single
zero-free-parameter framework, derivable from one geometric principle,
that takes first place across all three available rankings (fit quality,
